author: Muhammad Zulhusni
description:
IBM has committed $5 billion to Project Lightwell, a joint initiative with Red Hat focused on open-source software security. The initiative will involve more than 20,000 engineers and AI tools. IBM said the project will identify and fix vulnerabilities across open-source software used in corporate technology environments.
